request.details: Set cwd relative to the attempt worktree.

response.details: This token is mapped to a Graph attempt. Self-check runs in that attempt's own worktree (the tree the remote source tools read and write), not in the group worktree, and cwd is relative to that tree. attempt_id and input_commit in the run and read responses are the run's basis (the attempt and the commit its tree started from); source_head_before/after are the attempt tree's HEAD. Source writes to this attempt tree are locked while the run executes; when the run's process tree is not proved empty at its end (recovery_incomplete), the lock stays protected until that is proved. The run slot is one per Group, not per attempt.

errors.guidance: The run is stopping or the attempt was invalidated, so no Self-check can start for this attempt -> do not call again; report details (reason, attempt_id) in the TR. Do not route around it through the group worktree or a local run.
The attempt's own worktree cannot be confirmed (not prepared, tree missing, marker mismatch, ... see details.reason) -> report the reason in the TR. The group worktree is never used in its place.
